quest.title: Moonlight Sonata: Lingering Resonance
quest.description: The Damselette seems to be playing with kuuhenki in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try calm and gentle...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: That was lovely. So you really did memorize my tune.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, only 'cause you're such a great singer! Whenever we hear your voice, sometimes we stop for a bit just to listen...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hm, the kuuhenki seemed quite enraptured with your performance as well. Perhaps they picked up a few things...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I might require your educational assistance again in the future.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Come, give me your hand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? No, no, this was a free performance. No tuition fee required!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm? Tuition fee?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I only thought... the gentle glow of moonlight would make a fitting accompaniment for such a beautiful melody.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The kuuhenki seem quite content for the day. Even so... I may have to trouble you to drop by again when they wish to learn more.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: We have pierced through cloud and fog, and together, witnessed the answer on the moon... Its beauty is like the music your strings now sing.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here? The kuuhenki are playing the lyre again. Could you play a song for them like last time?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: And I happen to be in the mood to hear something different myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hmm, what should I play...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try the one Columbina always sings...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try the one Columbina always sings...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (But what tone should I go for...)

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Oh, it's over already? I could listen to that forever...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: As I once told you, this is the only lullaby I can remember.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Although I have yet to discern the meaning behind it, after hearing you play, I feel like whatever answer is waiting for me, up there on the moon... at the very least, it must be a beautiful one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's okay. Seriously, you don't need to give us anything in return.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Ah, that wasn't my intention... I only wished to adorn your melody with a ray of gentle moonlight.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's make it cheerful...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try something from another nation...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try something from another nation...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: How curious... I have heard melodies like this before, but your playing lends a whole new dimension...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ah, maybe because {NICKNAME} was channeling {M#his}{F#her} emotional connection to that place...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: What's curious is that... I feel as if I can picture the landscape just by listening to the melody. I wonder how the real thing compares to my imagination...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You should just go see it someday! We can be your tour guides!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Mm... Perhaps. If that day ever comes.
